question: Can a small present-stream head learn a stable relative contribution from the original POS and A02 probabilities beyond fixed MIX50, when compared with a one-score calibration control?
estimand: Temporal predictive comparison of two fixed-probability meta-heads against unchanged MIX50 on rows with exact saved Train OOF predictions; this is not a causal estimate.

source_boundaries.fit_and_evaluation_rows: Saved official Train OOF predictions only; labels are read from official Train by exact record_id and validated cycle_code after ROOT_PREFIT_PASS.
source_boundaries.test: E79 probabilities and official Test IDs may be read only after both final OOF head states and their receipts are durable and the E79 application freeze is written.
source_boundaries.oof_label_arrays: Never loaded from the OOF NPZ; labels are obtained only by the approved ID-keyed Train reader.

final_unique_stitch.definition: E67 cycles 68-75 plus E75 cycles 76-79; exclude duplicate E67 W6 rows.

PAIR.purpose: Estimate relative contributions of the frozen POS and A02 probabilities.

SCALAR.purpose: Control for a single-score calibration/intercept change without learning relative component contributions.

stages.role: Final OOF-trained head for frozen E79 application; no in-sample score is used for selection

fit_budget.retry_policy: No retries. A started fit with no durable exact state/receipt is terminal failure; resume only from an exact persisted receipt without refitting.

evaluation.pairwise_errors: Report disagreement with MIX50 and correct/incorrect changes for PAIR and SCALAR.

C15.result: two-score C2_B plus sparse meta-head retired: primary gain -0.001339; H12_L gain +0.003281; two supported high-text-load positive-recall guard failures. Not a direct comparator to POS+A02.

MIX50_temporal_decision.baseline: fixed MIX50 threshold 0.50; same unique W5/W6 rows
MIX50_temporal_decision.result: past-only scalar threshold transfers slightly worse: pooled delta -0.000505. Counterevidence against assuming calibration alone helps; not a direct test of relative score weights.

learned_pair_pilot_v2.baseline: separate factorization-machine/no-pair and observed A02 controls; differs from this LR and same-baseline MIX50 comparisons
learned_pair_pilot_v2.result: rank-16 learned pair diagnostic-only with mechanism and competition gates failed. Context only; not a direct comparator.

interpretation_limits: OOF-head temporal gains are predictive associations, not causal effects.
A final fit on all OOF labels is not an independent validation result.
C15, V2 calibration, and factorization-machine results use different estimands/baselines and must not be pooled as if they were the same experiment.
A E79 candidate CSV is not a qualified champion and must not be submitted by this runner.
